use: Small input without leaving the page.
avoid: One sentence on hover: use Tooltip.
figmaProps: Side of the arrow. Top: the popover sits below the button.
Show title / Closable / Show text / Show content / Show actions
reactProps: Arrow that points to the middle of the button. Default false.
behaviour: Focus moves to the panel when it opens and back to the button when it closes.
a11y: Non-modal dialog with the title as its name.
open: In code the popover always opens below the button. Bottom, Left and Right only exist in Figma.
name: Popover
summary: Panel next to a button with an explanation or a small form. Closes with the close button, Escape or a click outside.
